observations.note: The judge opened only 2 of the 5 changed documents and admitted it skipped the overview spec and the other self-improvement and session-review specs, so the brief should require opening every changed file before any MET.
For the SIL-B14 and SRV-B12 behaviour sentences, which grep output had cut off, the judge relied on the hand-off's description instead of reading the lines in the file.

All criteria were graded MET although some rested on search-only lines, which the intent says to grade PARTIAL, so the behaviour and generality criteria should demand a quoted file line with its path and line number.
